design_issues.screen: Public landing (both desktop + mobile) — cookies banner
issues: The bottom-right Cookies banner (accept-all / essential-only / customise) sits above the fold on mobile and overlaps content until dismissed. Non-blocking for anon flow but worth noting alongside iter140 Sonner-toast concern.

Rendered as 'LIVE RADIO.AI RADIO.MORE THAN RADIO.' with no space between periods — it's three <span> lines so visually correct at desktop/mobile, but if the H1 is ever inlined the microcopy will run together. Cosmetic only.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: dismiss/gate the cookies banner sooner (or move to top on mobile) so it doesn't compete with hero CTAs.
critical_code_review_comments: banner_ads_v2._require_admin(u) correctly accepts BOTH u.get('is_admin') AND u.get('role')=='admin' (line 421-423) — fix confirmed. Admin approve/reject only match status:'pending' and return 404 not_pending otherwise — correct semantics.

shell.py /home top_genre logic (lines 454-462) reads preference_vector.genres FIRST, falls back to favorite_genres, title-cases first entry, returns None on any exception. Anonymous request path returns top_genre=None (no crash). This matches review spec #D.
AdvertiserBannerCampaigns.RightRailSlotsPanel renders advertiser-rail-analytics only when ≥1 rail campaign exists — good. Totals row is always shown when panel present.
AdminRailAds.jsx uses window.confirm before approve/reject — testing had to accept the dialog. Fine for admin surface.

PublicHomeNewLookV2 covers 100% of testIDs listed in the review spec including public-cta-createradio/dining/earn/premium/app; premium copy explicitly states rolling-hour skip counts (not 'Unlimited') per spec.
seed_data_creation: Backend regression tests idempotently create 2 pending banner_ads_v2 rail campaigns per run under test@ (one gets approved, one rejected). Safe to leave; visible under /admin/rail-ads → All tab. Existing bcamp_865ca71ee3a64d that was PENDING has been APPROVED as part of the UI approve test — expected side-effect.
